questions.q: Under RBI guidelines, what is the maximum transaction limit for UPI Lite without entering a UPI PIN?
questions.e: RBI raised the per-transaction limit for UPI Lite to ₹500, with a cumulative wallet limit of ₹2,000.

questions.q: Which of the following documents is NOT considered an Officially Valid Document (OVD) for Individual KYC?
questions.e: Ration card is not recognized as an Officially Valid Document (OVD) under RBI Master Direction on KYC.

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of the Prompt Corrective Action (PCA) framework enforced by the Reserve Bank of India?
o: To monitor banks with weak financial metrics before crisis
questions.e: PCA is an early-intervention supervisory framework assessing Capital, Asset Quality, and Leverage.

questions.q: Under the Canara Bank Retail Lending Scheme, what is the standard CIBIL score benchmark generally required for preferential home loan interest rates?
questions.e: A credit bureau (CIBIL) score of 750 and above qualifies borrowers for standard preferential retail rate slabs.

questions.q: What is the maximum insurance coverage provided to a bank depositor by DICGC per bank?
questions.e: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) insures deposits up to ₹5 Lakhs per depositor across accounts in the same bank.

questions.q: In cyber fraud prevention, what is the national helpline number for reporting financial cybercrime in India?
questions.e: 1930 is the dedicated national cyber financial fraud reporting helpline connected to the Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting and Management System.
